abstract: Asia-Pacific has undergone a profound transformation over the past few decades, increasing its share in global trade and GDP. This paper assesses to what extent Asia-Pacific’s role in global finance has expanded commensurately and whether it has become more integrated by systematically analyzing crossborder financial data. We combine descriptive analyses of past trends in financial positions with network analysis to understand how inter- and intra- regional financial linkages have evolved for economies in the region. We find that Asia-Pacific’s role in global finance still significantly lags its role in global trade and that there is considerable heterogeneity within the region. Advanced economies in the region are well integrated into global financial markets, whereas most emerging markets exhibit more limited integration. Financial integration within the region is also low but diverges significantly by instrument. Intra-regional financial integration is advancing in foreign direct investment (FDI) and cross-border banking (the latter from low levels), but has remained limited in foreign portfolio investment (FPI). Gravity model analysis indicates a significant association between trade and FDI, but not between trade and FPI. We conclude the paper with policy recommendations to promote resilient financial integration in Asia-Pacific.
abstract_zh: 亚太地区在过去几十年经历了深刻变革，其在全球贸易和GDP中的份额不断提升。本文通过系统分析跨境金融数据，评估亚太地区在全球金融中的角色是否相应扩大，以及其金融一体化程度是否加深。我们结合对金融头寸历史趋势的描述性分析与网络分析，以理解该地区经济体之间及区域内金融联系的演变。研究发现，亚太地区在全球金融中的作用仍显著落后于其在全球贸易中的地位，且区域内存在较大异质性。该地区的发达经济体已深度融入全球金融市场，而大多数新兴市场的融入程度则较为有限。区域内金融一体化水平同样较低，但不同工具间差异显著。区域内金融一体化在外商直接投资（FDI）和跨境银行业务（后者起点较低）方面有所推进，但在外国证券投资（FPI）方面仍较为有限。引力模型分析表明，贸易与FDI之间存在显著关联，但贸易与FPI之间并无显著关联。本文最后提出政策建议，以促进亚太地区具有韧性的金融一体化。

abstract: Fuel and food constitute significant portions of consumer baskets, yet their prices are highly volatile. The renewed energy price shock in March 2026, driven by geopolitical disruptions and supply constraints, has highlighted the macroeconomic and distributional importance of how international price shocks transmit to domestic markets. Spikes in these prices can have major social, political, and economic implications. The conventional policy approach is to allow domestic retail prices to align with international prices while protecting the most vulnerable. However, many countries intervene in price settings to shield their domestic markets from global fluctuations. This paper provides a comprehensive assessment of the passthrough from global to domestic retail prices for four commodities: gasoline, diesel, wheat, and rice over the past two decades in many countries. We employ a dynamic model of local projections building on the work of Kpodar and Abdallah (2017). Our findings indicate that average passthrough is incomplete, with fuel exhibiting higher and faster passthrough than food. The extent of passthrough varies by period, region, and between commodity exporters and importers. We also examine asymmetric responses to global price shocks and find evidence of a ratchet effect: price increases are more likely to be passed through than decreases.
abstract_zh: 燃料和食品在消费者篮子中占据重要份额，但其价格波动剧烈。2026年3月由地缘政治干扰和供应约束引发的新一轮能源价格冲击，凸显了国际价格冲击向国内市场传导的宏观经济和分配重要性。这些价格的飙升可能带来重大的社会、政治和经济影响。传统政策做法是允许国内零售价格与国际价格接轨，同时保护最弱势群体。然而，许多国家通过干预价格设定来保护其国内市场免受全球波动的影响。本文对过去二十年间多个国家中四种商品（汽油、柴油、小麦和大米）从全球价格向国内零售价格的传导进行了全面评估。我们采用基于Kpodar和Abdallah（2017）研究的动态局部投影模型。研究结果表明，平均传导是不完全的，燃料的传导速度和程度均高于食品。传导程度因时期、地区以及商品出口国和进口国之间的差异而有所不同。我们还考察了对全球价格冲击的非对称反应，并发现了棘轮效应的证据：价格上涨比下跌更可能被传导。

abstract: We examine market entry and post-entry debt dynamics in Frontier Economies by grouping countries based on durability of market access using a two-step framework combining first Eurobond issuance with the reliance on private external creditors, validated through an unsupervised K-mean clustering. A discrete-time event LOGIT model finds that favorable global liquidity conditions and investor appetite open issuance windows for countries, but domestic pull factors—income, institutions, growth, and reserve buffers—ultimately determine success of market entry. Post-entry, Frontier Economies shift rapidly toward market borrowing, with looser fiscal stance as new financing source is unlocked. Along increased exposure to rollover and global financial cycle risks, debt decomposition exercise shows a worsening interest–growth differential and rising debt, driven mainly by primary deficits and higher interest burdens. Results underscore the need for credible medium-term fiscal frameworks, stronger debt management, and reserve buffers to manage the transition to market financing.
abstract_zh: 我们通过两步框架，依据市场准入的持久性对国家进行分组，结合首次欧元债券发行与对私人外部债权人的依赖，并借助无监督K均值聚类进行验证，来考察前沿经济体的市场进入及进入后的债务动态。一个离散时间事件LOGIT模型发现，有利的全球流动性条件和投资者偏好为各国打开了发行窗口，但国内拉动因素——收入、制度、增长及储备缓冲——最终决定了市场进入的成功与否。进入市场后，前沿经济体迅速转向市场借贷，随着新融资来源的解锁，财政立场趋于宽松。在面临展期风险和全球金融周期风险增加的同时，债务分解分析显示，利息-增长差恶化，债务上升，主要驱动因素为基本赤字和更高的利息负担。研究结果强调了可信的中期财政框架、加强债务管理及储备缓冲对于管理向市场融资过渡的必要性。
title: Beyond the First Bond: Market Access and Debt Dynamics in Frontier Economies

abstract: The European Union designates 26% of its landmass as protected areas, limiting economic development for biodiversity. We use the staggered introduction of protected areas between 1985 and 2019 to study the selection of protected land and the causal effect of protection on vegetation cover and nightlights. We find no meaningful impacts on either outcome across four decades, countries, protection cohorts, or land characteristics. These null effects are consistent with the political economy of EU land protection: weak incentives to internalize biodiversity gains, green-glow motives, and area-based targets shape local siting and stringency choices. In practice, strict protection is applied where development pressure is low–so that protection has little bite—while in high-pressure regions, protection is typically weak, imposing only limited constraints on economic activity.
abstract_zh: 欧盟将其26%的陆地面积划定为保护区，从而限制经济发展以保护生物多样性。我们利用1985年至2019年间保护区逐步设立的过程，研究保护区的选址机制以及保护措施对植被覆盖率和夜间灯光数据的因果效应。研究发现，在四十年间、不同国家、不同保护批次或不同土地特征下，保护措施对上述两项指标均未产生显著影响。这种零效应与欧盟土地保护的政治经济学逻辑一致：内部化生物多样性收益的激励不足、"绿色光环"动机以及基于面积的目标设定，共同塑造了地方选址与保护强度的选择。实践中，严格保护措施往往施加于开发压力较低的区域——因此保护效果甚微——而在高开发压力地区，保护措施通常较为薄弱，对经济活动仅构成有限约束。
authors: Tristan Grupp, Prakash Mishra, Mathias Reynaert, and Arthur A. van Benthem
title: An Evaluation of Protected Area Policies in the European Union

abstract: We develop a Transmission Growth-at-Risk (TGaR) framework that incorporates foreign financial vulnerabilities as predictors of U.S. downside growth risk. We distinguish financial conditions, which measure current tightness in credit markets, from financial vulnerabilities, which measure structural fragilities that can amplify shocks. Elevated foreign financial vulnerabilities are associated with lower U.S. growth-at-risk, with transmission through both trade linkages and dollar integration channels. Asset valuation pressures and financial sector leverage abroad have the largest estimated amplification effects. Financial conditions primarily affect near-term tail risk, while foreign vulnerabilities weigh on U.S. GDP at a medium-term horizon. Out of sample, adding foreign vulnerabilities raises the predictive score by 53 percent at the 8-quarter horizon. Crisis-episode evidence points to the same interpretation. These findings show that monitoring foreign financial vulnerabilities is important for gauging U.S. growth prospects.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个“传导增长风险”（TGaR）框架，将外国金融脆弱性纳入美国下行增长风险的预测变量。我们区分了金融状况（衡量信贷市场当前紧缩程度）与金融脆弱性（衡量可能放大冲击的结构性脆弱性）。外国金融脆弱性升高与美国增长风险下降相关，其传导渠道包括贸易联系和美元一体化路径。海外资产估值压力与金融部门杠杆率具有最大的放大效应估计值。金融状况主要影响短期尾部风险，而外国脆弱性则在中期时间范围内对美国GDP产生压力。在样本外检验中，加入外国脆弱性指标后，8个季度预测期的预测评分提升了53%。危机时期的证据也指向相同解释。这些发现表明，监测外国金融脆弱性对于评估美国增长前景至关重要。
title: Transmission Growth-at-Risk: How Foreign Financial Vulnerabilities Shape U.S. Growth Prospects

abstract: This paper provides a method to study quantile effects in discrete choice with social interactions. The method is based on a behavioral social interactions model from quantile preference in decision making and demonstrates peer effects on different quantiles of discrete outcomes. The peer effects parameters are estimated by a nested pseudoscore (NPS) approach, which is developed to tackle the computational burden pertaining to the social interactions model. Consistency and asymptotic normality are established for the proposed NPS estimator. We illustrate the finite sample performance of the model and the estimator by Monte Carlo experiments and an application of peer effects among students on exercise decisions, using the National Longitudinal Study of Adolescent Health dataset.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种研究存在社会互动时离散选择中分位数效应的方法。该方法基于决策过程中分位数偏好的行为社会互动模型，揭示了同伴效应对离散结果不同分位数的影响。为应对社会互动模型带来的计算负担，我们开发了嵌套伪得分（NPS）方法对同伴效应参数进行估计，并建立了该NPS估计量的一致性和渐近正态性。通过蒙特卡洛实验以及基于美国青少年健康纵向研究数据集的学生运动决策中同伴效应的应用分析，我们验证了模型与估计量的有限样本表现。

abstract: We study the aftermath of the 1968 Washington, D.C. civil disturbance to illuminate the mechanisms that drive urban redevelopment in the presence of low demand and racial tension. Using a within-block identification strategy, we show that destruction caused lots to remain vacant for the next thirty years and only recently converge in terms of structure value. The city acted to preclude for-profit land owners from leaving land vacant until demand conditions improved by purchasing nearly half of all properties in damaged neighborhoods. Despite this and other steps, the city had limited success in speeding up redevelopment.
abstract_zh: 本文研究1968年华盛顿特区民事骚乱的后续影响，以揭示在低需求与种族紧张背景下驱动城市再开发的机制。通过采用街区内识别策略，我们证明破坏导致地块在此后三十年间持续空置，直至近期才在建筑价值上趋于收敛。市政府通过收购受损街区近半数房产，阻止营利性土地所有者在地产需求改善前闲置土地。尽管采取了这一措施及其他举措，市政府在加速再开发方面成效有限。
title: Destruction, Policy, and the Evolving Consequences of Washington, DC’s 1968 Civil Disturbance
title_zh: 华盛顿特区1968年民乱：破坏、政策与不断演变的后果

abstract: We examine how the 1993 Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) impacts the gender composition at U.S. firms experiencing a negative demand shock. Combining changes in Chinese imports across industries between 2000 and 2003 and a sharp regression discontinuity to identify FMLA status, we find that an increase in import competition decreases the share of female employment, earnings, and promotions at FMLA relative to non-FMLA firms. This effect is driven by women in prime child-bearing ages and without college degrees and is pronounced at firms with all male managers. These results suggest that job-protected leave mandates may exacerbate gender inequalities in response to adverse shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了1993年《家庭与医疗休假法案》（FMLA）如何影响遭受负面需求冲击的美国企业的性别构成。通过结合2000年至2003年间各行业中国进口变化，并利用断点回归方法识别FMLA适用状态，我们发现：相较于非FMLA企业，进口竞争加剧导致FMLA企业中女性就业比例、收入及晋升机会下降。这一效应主要由处于生育黄金年龄且未获得大学学位的女性群体驱动，并在管理层全为男性的企业中尤为显著。研究结果表明，带薪休假保障政策可能加剧企业在应对负面冲击时的性别不平等现象。

abstract: Using panel data on a 20% random sample of Canadian taxpayers, we study behavioral responses to the cancellation of a lifetime capital gains exemption that resulted in increased capital gains taxation for some individuals. We show that the exemption did not change the number of taxpayers reporting positive capital gains, and thus unlikely resulted in increased participation in capital markets. Furthermore, our results suggest that the cancellation increased the long-run capital gains realizations of tax filers with more unused exemption room but had a small, statistically insignificant impact on the capital gains realizations of those with little unused exemption room.
abstract_zh: 利用加拿大纳税人20%随机样本的面板数据，我们研究了终身资本利得豁免取消对行为的影响，该取消导致部分个人的资本利得税负增加。研究表明，豁免并未改变申报正资本利得的纳税人数量，因此不太可能促进资本市场参与度的提升。此外，我们的结果表明，豁免取消增加了未使用豁免额度较多的纳税人的长期资本利得实现，但对未使用豁免额度较少的纳税人的资本利得实现影响较小且统计上不显著。

abstract: This study extends the behavioral theory of the firm by reconceptualizing performance feedback as a multidimensional construct that captures performance relative to aspiration levels and performance relative to underlying potential. We define four feedback categories: legitimated success (performance above both aspiration levels and underlying potential), fragile success (performance above aspiration levels but below underlying potential), potential-confirming failure (performance below aspiration levels but above underlying potential), and structural failure (performance below both aspiration levels and underlying potential). Using panel data on 213 team-seasons from the Korea Baseball Organization (2001–2025), we examine how each feedback type influences risk-taking decisions in the form of top leadership changes and workforce reconfiguration. Our analyses show that structural failure is associated with a higher likelihood of replacing the top leader, whereas legitimated success corresponds to greater leadership stability. In addition, potential-confirming failure triggers significant workforce reconfiguration, whereas both types of success entail minimal workforce changes. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating underlying potential into performance feedback evaluation. By jointly considering performance relative to aspiration levels and underlying potential, this study advances a more precise account of how firms interpret performance outcomes and, consequently, when they pursue strategic change versus reinforce the status quo.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过将绩效反馈重新概念化为一个多维构念（同时捕捉相对于期望水平的绩效和相对于潜在能力的绩效），拓展了企业行为理论。我们定义了四种反馈类型：合法化成功（绩效高于期望水平和潜在能力）、脆弱成功（绩效高于期望水平但低于潜在能力）、潜力确认型失败（绩效低于期望水平但高于潜在能力）以及结构性失败（绩效低于期望水平和潜在能力）。基于韩国棒球组织2001-2025年间213个团队赛季的面板数据，我们考察了每种反馈类型如何通过高层领导更替和劳动力重组的形式影响风险承担决策。分析表明，结构性失败与高层领导更替概率升高相关，而合法化成功则对应更高的领导稳定性。此外，潜力确认型失败会引发显著的劳动力重组，而两种成功类型均涉及最小程度的劳动力变动。这些发现凸显了将潜在能力纳入绩效反馈评估的重要性。通过联合考虑相对于期望水平和潜在能力的绩效，本研究更精确地阐释了企业如何解读绩效结果，进而决定何时追求战略变革或维持现状。关键词：绩效反馈 企业行为理论 潜在能力 领导更替 劳动力重组 JEL分类：L22 D81 M12
title: Revisiting performance feedback: aspiration levels, underlying potential, and risk-taking behavior
title_zh: 重新审视绩效反馈：期望水平、潜在能力与风险承担行为

abstract: In the context of the digital economy reshaping new forms of employment while social security coverage for flexibly employed workers remains inadequate,this study, set against the backdrop of digital economy reshaping employment and insufficient social security for flexibly employed workers, uses CFPS microdata to systematically analyze the impact and mechanisms of digital technology use on pension insurance participation. Empirically, digital technology use significantly promotes participation, a finding robust to various sensitivity tests. Mechanistically, it facilitates participation by raising income, job satisfaction, and trust in social security. Interestingly, the contribution base plays a negative moderating role. Heterogeneity reveals that the positive effect is stronger among middle-aged and older workers, agricultural hukou holders, less-educated, and married groups. Policy recommendations include a targeted digital expansion strategy, optimized contribution parameters accommodating flexible work, and a long-term promotion mechanism centered on improving job quality and institutional trust, so as to sustainably increase pension insurance participation.
abstract_zh: 在数字经济重塑新型就业形态而灵活就业人员社会保障覆盖不足的背景下，本研究利用CFPS微观数据，系统分析了数字技术使用对养老保险参与的影响及其作用机制。实证结果表明，数字技术使用显著促进了养老保险参与，该结论在多种敏感性检验中保持稳健。机制分析显示，数字技术通过提高收入水平、工作满意度及社会保障信任度来促进参保。值得注意的是，缴费基数在其中发挥负向调节作用。异质性分析表明，该正向效应在中老年群体、农业户籍、低学历及已婚群体中更为显著。政策建议包括：实施精准化数字推广策略、优化适应灵活就业的缴费参数设计，以及构建以提升工作质量与制度信任为核心的长期促进机制，从而持续提高养老保险参保率。关键词：数字技术；灵活就业；养老保险参保；JEL分类：H55；O33

abstract: This paper documents five empirical facts about the role of strategic complementarities in firms’ price-setting behavior, using administrative data on Chilean firms. (1) Strategic complementarities play a dominant role in price setting, exerting a stronger influence than changes in marginal costs. (2) While the strength of strategic complementarities varies across sectors, it consistently outweighs the role of cost changes. (3) In high-inflation environments, firms become more responsive to changes in their competitors’ prices. (4) Firms respond more strongly to competitors’ price increases than to price decreases, mirroring the ‘rockets and feathers’ phenomenon of costs. (5) Strategic complementarities are stronger among firms with fewer competitors, larger market shares, and broader customer bases. These findings suggest that strategic complementarities — a source of real rigidities — are quantitatively important, state-dependent, asymmetric, and shaped by market structure.
abstract_zh: 本文利用智利企业的行政数据，记录了关于战略性互补在企业定价行为中作用的五项实证事实。（1）战略性互补在定价中占据主导地位，其影响力超过边际成本变化。（2）尽管战略性互补的强度在不同行业间存在差异，但其作用始终超过成本变化的影响。（3）在高通胀环境下，企业对竞争对手价格变动的反应更为敏感。（4）企业对竞争对手提价的反应强于对降价的反应，这反映了成本变动的“火箭与羽毛”现象。（5）在竞争对手较少、市场份额较大且客户基础更广的企业中，战略性互补更为显著。这些发现表明，战略性互补——作为实际刚性的来源——在数量上具有重要意义，具有状态依赖性、非对称性，并受市场结构影响。
title: Beyond costs: The dominant role of strategic complementarities in pricing
title_zh: 超越成本：战略互补性在定价中的主导作用

abstract: This paper asks whether authors’ ability to manipulate AI referees necessarily undermines peer review, or whether it can sometimes improve it. We model a journal in which authors privately know quality, referees choose between costly manual review and cheap AI delegation, and editors may investigate suspicious recommendations. Hidden prompts can force AI to recommend acceptance, but prompt detection is imperfect. With the baseline referee incentives and sequentially rational, non-committed investigation, manual-only review is unsustainable once AI is available, and there is no robust pure-strategy AI-only equilibrium with manipulation. Most notably, under the welfare criterion studied here, prompt injection can be welfare improving on an open set of primitives: in certain monitoring equilibria, manipulation makes positive AI reports more suspicious or more exposed to audit, induces editor investigation, and helps sustain manual review where prompt-free standard inspection would fail. Stronger prompt detection is, therefore, not unconditionally better; within the focal equilibrium menu, it can eliminate a monitoring regime without replacing it with a higher-welfare one. abstract_zh: 本文探讨作者操纵AI审稿人的能力是否必然损害同行评审，抑或有时能改进评审机制。我们构建了一个期刊模型：作者私下知晓论文质量，审稿人可在高成本人工评审与低成本AI委托之间选择，编辑则可能对可疑推荐展开调查。隐藏提示可强制AI推荐接收，但提示检测并不完美。在基准审稿人激励与序贯理性、非承诺调查条件下，一旦AI可用，纯人工评审便不可持续，且不存在稳健的纯策略AI均衡（含操纵行为）。尤为值得注意的是，在所研究的福利标准下，提示注入可在开集参数上改善福利：在某些监控均衡中，操纵行为使正面AI报告更可疑或更易受审计，促使编辑展开调查，并在无提示的标准审查失效时维持人工评审。因此，更强的提示检测并非无条件更优；在焦点均衡集合内，它可能消除一种监控机制，却未代之以更高福利的机制。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
source_issue: Journal of Economic Behavior & Organization, Volume 249
title: Can author manipulation of AI referees be welfare improving?
title_zh: 作者操纵AI审稿人能否提升福利？

abstract: We develop a dynamic model of autocracy in which repression helps quell acute threats, increasing an autocrat’s survival probability or deterring challenges altogether, but at the expense of policies that reduce popular discontent and future opposition mobilization. Our main contribution is characterizing a unique stationary Markov Perfect equilibrium, which takes one of three forms: deterrence, where the autocrat is never challenged; instability, where challenges occur every period; or a deterrence/contention mixed-strategy equilibrium with periods of deterrence and periods with challenges. The mixed-strategy equilibrium arises because the opposition is easier to deter today when they expect opportunities to challenge in the future. We then examine indirect foreign interference–such as sanctions or withholding aid–aimed at protecting the opposition or promoting democratization. Even under ideal conditions, such interference cannot achieve both goals simultaneously.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个专制政权的动态模型，其中镇压有助于平息严重威胁，提高独裁者的生存概率或完全阻止挑战，但代价是采取减少民众不满和未来反对派动员的政策。我们的主要贡献在于刻画了一个独特的平稳马尔可夫完美均衡，该均衡呈现三种形式之一：威慑，即独裁者从未受到挑战；不稳定，即每个时期都发生挑战；或威慑/抗争混合策略均衡，其中存在威慑期和挑战期。混合策略均衡之所以出现，是因为当反对派预期未来有机会发起挑战时，他们今天更容易被威慑。随后，我们考察了旨在保护反对派或促进民主化的间接外国干预——如制裁或暂停援助。即使在理想条件下，此类干预也无法同时实现这两个目标。
title: Repression and Autocratic Consolidation
title_zh: 压制与威权巩固

abstract: This paper reexamines the consequences of mass layoffs in the French manufacturing sector by linking individual displacement costs to broader local labor-market outcomes. Using matched employer–employee data from 1995 to 2019 and a unified definition of mass layoffs, it provides the first joint assessment of their individual and aggregate effects. Displaced workers experience large and persistent employment and earnings losses. At the local level, unemployment and the number of job seekers rise sharply and remain elevated for several years, with a large local employment multiplier. Two mechanisms connect individual losses to aggregate outcomes: a demand channel, whereby larger wage losses among displaced workers amplify local unemployment, and a housing-related mobility channel linking local housing market conditions to workers’ geographic mobility. Worker reallocations themselves appear inefficient: displaced high-quality workers become less likely to match with high-productivity establishments, while destination firms display lower investment rates and lower value added. We also uncover a critical measurement bias affecting labor productivity assessments. Under standard accounting conventions — where temporary agency workers and their value added are recorded in the service sector rather than in the manufacturing establishments where they actually work — mass layoffs appear to raise productivity. Correcting for this bias fully reverses this apparent productivity gain and instead reveals a substantial productivity decline. Overall, mass layoffs appear individually and socially costly.
abstract_zh: 本文通过将个体置换成本与更广泛的本地劳动力市场结果相联系，重新审视了法国制造业部门大规模裁员的后果。利用1995年至2019年的匹配雇主-雇员数据，并采用统一的大规模裁员定义，本文首次对其个体与总体效应进行了联合评估。被置换的工人经历了巨大且持续的就业和收入损失。在地方层面，失业率和求职者数量急剧上升，并在数年内保持高位，同时存在显著的本地就业乘数效应。两种机制将个体损失与总体结果联系起来：一是需求渠道，即被置换工人更大的工资损失加剧了本地失业；二是与住房相关的流动性渠道，将本地住房市场条件与工人的地理流动性相联系。工人自身的重新配置似乎效率低下：被置换的高质量工人与高生产率企业匹配的可能性降低，而目的地企业则表现出较低的投资率和增加值。我们还揭示了一个影响劳动生产率评估的关键测量偏差。在标准会计惯例下——即临时机构工人及其增加值被记录在服务部门，而非其实际工作的制造业机构中——大规模裁员看似提高了生产率。纠正这一偏差后，这一表面上的生产率提升完全逆转，反而揭示了显著的生产率下降。总体而言，大规模裁员在个体层面和社会层面均代价高昂。
title: Are mass layoffs individually costly but socially beneficial?
title_zh: 大规模裁员是否对个人代价高昂但对社会有益？

abstract: This paper provides new evidence of local protectionism by examining government information disclosure and suggests that public information reporting may serve as a potential channel through which governments favor local firms. Focusing on China’s food safety information disclosure, we compare food safety testing results conducted by local and national administrations for the same product within the same manufacturer and year. Our findings reveal a significantly lower probability of failure in food safety tests conducted by the local prefectural administration, holding across model specifications, accounting for different fixed effects, collusions between manufacturers and independent inspection agencies, technical differences in testing between administrations and the impact of the pandemic. Food manufacturing firms with higher registration capital and those strategic to local economies show lower probability of failure reported by local administrations, particularly in regions with aggressive GDP growth targets. This implies competition among regional governments drives a local bias in public information reporting, undermining the accuracy and transparency of food safety disclosure.
abstract_zh: 本文通过考察政府信息公开提供了地方保护主义的新证据，并指出公共信息报告可能是政府偏袒本地企业的一个潜在渠道。聚焦于中国的食品安全信息公开，我们比较了同一制造商、同一年度内地方与国家行政机构对同一产品进行的食品安全检测结果。研究发现，地方市级行政机构进行的食品安全检测不合格概率显著较低，这一结论在多种模型设定下稳健，包括考虑不同的固定效应、制造商与独立检测机构之间的合谋、行政机构间检测技术差异以及疫情的影响。注册资本较高及对地方经济具有战略意义的食品制造企业，在地方行政机构报告中的不合格概率更低，尤其是在GDP增长目标激进的地区。这表明地方政府间的竞争导致了公共信息报告中的本地偏向，削弱了食品安全信息披露的准确性和透明度。

title: Local protectionism in China’s government disclosure of food safety information
title_zh: 中国地方政府食品安全信息披露中的地方保护主义

abstract: Systemic importance has two dimensions, a bank’s contribution to system-wide tail risk ($\Delta$CoVaR) and its exposure to it (marginal expected shortfall, MES). Using daily $\Delta$CoVaR and MES for 24 publicly traded Global Systemically Important Banks over 2012–2025, we show the two rankings move on different clocks. Contribution rankings reorder at the same rate in calm times, the pandemic, and after. Exposure rankings survive the pandemic but re-anchor sharply at the 2022–2023 interest-rate regime change, as euro-area banks fall and US and Japanese banks rise. Shocks rotate which banks contribute to systemic risk; only regime changes move which are exposed.
abstract_zh: 系统重要性具有两个维度：银行对系统性尾部风险的贡献度（$\Delta$CoVaR）及其风险暴露程度（边际预期损失，MES）。基于2012-2025年间24家上市全球系统重要性银行的日度$\Delta$CoVaR与MES数据，我们发现两种排名遵循不同的时间节奏。贡献度排名在平稳时期、疫情期间及疫情后均以相同速率重新排序；而风险暴露排名虽经受住疫情冲击，却在2022-2023年利率制度转换时发生剧烈锚定调整——欧元区银行排名下降，美日银行排名上升。冲击会改变哪些银行构成系统性风险贡献者，唯有制度变迁才能改变哪些银行面临风险暴露。
title: The two clocks of systemic importance
title_zh: 系统重要性的两个时钟

abstract: Can broadband infrastructure serve as a catalyst for breaking intergenerational income links and promoting social mobility? This paper tries to answer this question by empirically examining the effects of broadband infrastructure on intergenerational income mobility in China. We exploit a quasi-natural experiment provided by the Broadband China Strategy (BCS) and employ a staggered difference-in-differences methodology to draw causal insights, revealing a 0.058 decrease in intergenerational income elasticity in pilot cities compared to non-pilot cities. The effect is particularly pronounced for males, cohorts born in the 1980 s, those whose fathers have rural hukou or lower levels of education, and residents in peri-urban areas surrounding major cities. Mechanism analyses suggest that the increase in intergenerational income mobility is primarily due to reshaping employment opportunities in favour of disadvantaged groups. These findings hold important implications not only for China but also for other developing countries undergoing digitalization.
abstract_zh: 宽带基础设施能否成为打破代际收入关联、促进社会流动的催化剂？本文通过实证检验宽带基础设施对中国代际收入流动性的影响来回答这一问题。我们利用"宽带中国"战略提供的准自然实验，采用交错双重差分法进行因果推断，发现试点城市的代际收入弹性较非试点城市下降了0.058。这一效应在男性、20世纪80年代出生群体、父亲为农村户籍或低学历者、以及大城市周边近郊居民中尤为显著。机制分析表明，代际收入流动性的提升主要源于就业机会向弱势群体的重新配置。这些发现不仅对中国具有重要启示，对正处于数字化转型进程中的其他发展中国家同样具有借鉴意义。

title: Breaking the links: broadband infrastructure and intergenerational income mobility

abstract: The carbon emissions trading mechanism increases production costs for regulated firms, which undoubtedly encourages enterprises to participate in technology research and development (R&D). However, it is unclear whether the carbon price will lead to misallocation of firms’ innovation resources. When R&D labour and capital are misallocated, increased R&D spending does not necessarily translate into innovation gains. Therefore, focusing on China’s carbon emissions trading mechanism, we systematically examine whether the carbon price affects firms’ innovation resource allocation and further evaluate social welfare after correcting for such misallocation. The analysis indicates that the carbon price exerts an inverted U-shaped effect on both R&D capital and labour misallocation; beyond a certain threshold, the carbon price helps reduce R&D resource misallocation. Further analysis indicates that correcting these misallocations significantly enhances both the quantity and quality of innovation output. These findings expand the research on carbon price mechanisms, highlight the importance of innovation resource allocation efficiency in climate governance, and provide evidence for designing carbon price policies that balance emission reduction targets with innovation efficiency.
abstract_zh: 碳排放交易机制提高了受监管企业的生产成本，这无疑会激励企业参与技术研发。然而，碳价格是否会导致企业创新资源的错配尚不明确。当研发劳动力和资本出现错配时，研发支出的增加并不必然转化为创新收益。因此，本文聚焦中国碳排放交易机制，系统考察碳价格是否影响企业创新资源配置，并进一步评估纠正此类错配后的社会福利效应。分析表明，碳价格对研发资本和劳动力错配均呈现倒U型影响；超过特定阈值后，碳价格有助于减少研发资源错配。进一步分析显示，纠正这些错配能显著提升创新产出的数量与质量。这些发现拓展了碳价格机制的研究，凸显了创新资源配置效率在气候治理中的重要性，并为设计兼顾减排目标与创新效率的碳价格政策提供了实证依据。关键词：碳价格 创新资源错配 研发资本错配 研发劳动力错配 福利分析 JEL分类：D21 M54 O32

title: Carbon price and the misallocation of enterprise innovation resources
title_zh: 碳价格与企业创新资源的错配

abstract: We study the impact of global value chain (GVC) participation on firms' innovation, productivity, and other indicators of technical change. Our dataset encompasses heterogeneous firms from 144 countries at different income levels over the period 2006–2025. Using difference‐in‐differences and matching strategies, we find that GVC participation leads to increased innovation and other technological improvements, with gains driven primarily at the extensive margin and by importing rather than exporting activities. Among innovation types, product innovation responds more strongly than process innovation. Importantly, the nature of innovation differs systematically across development levels: GVC participants in lower‐income countries benefit from access to foreign technology, while those operating in more advanced economies engage more in formal, R&D‐intensive innovation. JEL Classification : C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
abstract_zh: 我们研究了全球价值链（GVC）参与对企业创新、生产率及其他技术变革指标的影响。数据集涵盖2006–2025年间来自144个不同收入水平国家的异质性企业。通过双重差分法和匹配策略，我们发现GVC参与促进了创新及其他技术进步，其收益主要源于集约边际，且进口活动的作用强于出口活动。在创新类型中，产品创新的响应程度强于流程创新。重要的是，创新性质在不同发展水平上呈现系统性差异：低收入国家的GVC参与者受益于外国技术获取，而发达经济体的企业则更多从事正式的、研发密集型创新。 JEL分类：C31, F14, F15, O31, O33
title: Technical Change Through Global Value Chains: Evidence From Firms Worldwide
title_zh: 全球价值链中的技术变革：来自全球企业的证据

abstract: Does gentrification spread along intercity transport connections? We study the 2017 French high-speed rail (HSR) extensions from Paris to Bordeaux and Rennes. We build a model where HSR reduces the cost of accessing a primary city from a secondary one, enabling skilled workers to enjoy the primary city’s labor market while living in the more affordable secondary city. This induces migration from the primary to the secondary city, raising housing prices there. Empirically, the HSR connection raised housing prices in Bordeaux and Rennes by 12%, central-neighborhood median income by 2%, and within-neighborhood inequality by 2%. Near Montparnasse, the connecting Paris terminal, prices fell 4% relative to the rest of Paris.
abstract_zh: 绅士化是否会沿着城际交通连接扩散？我们研究了2017年法国高速铁路（HSR）从巴黎延伸至波尔多和雷恩的案例。我们构建了一个模型，其中高速铁路降低了从次级城市进入主要城市的成本，使得技能型工人能够在享受主要城市劳动力市场的同时，居住在更为负担得起的次级城市。这引发了从主要城市向次级城市的迁移，从而推高了次级城市的住房价格。实证结果显示，高速铁路连接使波尔多和雷恩的住房价格上涨了12%，中心街区收入中位数上升了2%，街区内不平等程度增加了2%。在巴黎连接终点站蒙帕纳斯附近，房价相对于巴黎其他地区下降了4%。
title: Second-hand gentrification: Theory and evidence from high-speed rail extensions
title_zh: 二手绅士化：高铁延伸的理论与实证

abstract: We develop a framework to compare the relative effectiveness of subsidizing alternative emission-reducing technologies. We show that an intermediate technology may reduce emissions more effectively than the cleanest technology if it induces sufficiently greater substitution away from the prevailing high-emission technology. We apply the framework to the South Korean passenger vehicle market using a demand model that incorporates mileage heterogeneity, an important determinant of fuel-type choice. First, reallocating existing subsidies from battery electric vehicles (BEVs), the cleanest technology, to hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs), an intermediate technology, would reduce total greenhouse gas emissions by an additional 47\%. Second, for a BEV-focused subsidy policy to outperform an HEV-focused policy, the carbon intensity of electricity generation would need to fall by approximately 45\%. Our findings suggest that HEV subsidies remain more effective than BEV subsidies until consumers become sufficiently willing to switch to BEVs or electricity generation becomes sufficiently decarbonized.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析框架，用于比较补贴不同减排技术的相对有效性。研究表明，若中间技术能显著促使消费者从当前高排放技术转向该技术，其减排效果可能优于最清洁技术。我们将该框架应用于韩国乘用车市场，采用了一个考虑里程异质性（影响燃料类型选择的关键因素）的需求模型。研究发现：第一，将现有补贴从最清洁的纯电动汽车（BEV）重新分配至中间技术的混合动力汽车（HEV），可使温室气体总排放量额外降低47%；第二，若要使以BEV为核心的补贴政策效果优于以HEV为核心的政策，电力生产的碳强度需下降约45%。结论表明，在消费者对BEV的转换意愿足够强烈或电力生产实现充分脱碳之前，HEV补贴始终比BEV补贴更有效。

title: Which Green Technology to Subsidize? Evidence from Electric Vehicles in South Korea
title_zh: 补贴哪种绿色技术？来自韩国电动汽车的证据

abstract: This article revives and enhances the factor-supply approach to estimate the effects of changes in immigrant supply on wages and employment of US natives. We introduce and validate a skill-based shift-share IV for immigrants’ labor supply. We find a positive impact of immigration on natives' employment and significant imperfect substitutability between natives and immigrants. Consistent with these estimates, we find significant task complementarity and occupational upgrading of native workers in response to immigrants. Finally, we calculate that immigration over 2000-2023 increased wages of non-college-educated natives by 2.6 to 3.4%, with small effects on other groups.
abstract_zh: 本文重新激活并完善了要素供给方法，用以估算移民供给变化对美国本土劳动者工资与就业的影响。我们提出并验证了一种基于技能的偏移份额工具变量，用于衡量移民劳动力供给。研究发现，移民对本土劳动者的就业具有正向影响，且本土劳动者与移民之间存在显著的不完全替代性。与这些估计结果一致，我们还发现本土劳动者在应对移民时表现出显著的任务互补性与职业升级。最后，我们测算得出，2000年至2023年间的移民使未受过大学教育的本土劳动者工资提高了2.6%至3.4%，而对其他群体的影响较小。
title: Immigration's Effect on US Wages and Employment Redux
title_zh: 移民对美国工资与就业的再审视

abstract: Some researchers argue that preferences for wealth accumulation contribute to the long-run stagnation of the Japanese economy. One theoretical implication of such preferences, particularly the assumption that the marginal utility of accumulated wealth has a strictly positive lower bound while that of consumption does not, is a widening of wealth inequality. We experimentally test this theoretical prediction by inducing preferences for wealth accumulation in the laboratory. We find partial support for the prediction: wealth inequality widens when initial inequality is large, but not when it is small. This occurs because high-wealth participants tend to overconsume more than low-wealth participants, partly offsetting the effect of induced preferences for wealth accumulation on inequality dynamics. Providing relative wealth-ranking information has only a limited impact on the widening of wealth inequality.
abstract_zh: 一些研究者认为，对财富积累的偏好是导致日本经济长期停滞的原因之一。此类偏好的一个理论含义——特别是假设累积财富的边际效用存在严格正下限而消费的边际效用不存在这一假设——会导致财富不平等扩大。我们通过实验室实验诱导被试产生财富积累偏好，对该理论预测进行检验。结果发现该预测得到部分支持：当初始不平等程度较高时，财富不平等会扩大；但当初始不平等程度较低时则不会。这是因为高财富参与者比低财富参与者更倾向于过度消费，这在一定程度上抵消了诱导的财富积累偏好对不平等动态的影响。提供相对财富排名信息对财富不平等扩大的影响有限。

title: Preferences for wealth accumulation and wealth inequality: Experimental evidence
title_zh: 财富积累偏好与财富不平等：实验证据

abstract: This study examines whether household tap water access affects income‐generating work time among employed rural adults in China. While existing studies have mainly examined the effects of improved water access on employment participation, off‐farm transition and household income, this paper focuses on the intensive margin of labour supply within existing livelihood activities. Drawing on household production and time allocation theory, household tap water access is conceptualised as reducing the time cost of routine domestic production, thereby releasing time that may be reallocated to income‐generating work and other household activities. Using rural panel data from the China Family Panel Studies from 2014 to 2022, the analysis applies individual fixed‐effects models and instrumental variables fixed‐effects (IV‐FE) estimates. The fixed effects results show that household tap water access is associated with approximately one additional hour of income‐generating work per week among employed rural adults. Under the IV identifying assumptions, the IV‐FE estimates suggest a larger positive effect. Additional time‐use analysis indicates that household tap water access reduces daily housework time by about 0.29 h and modestly increases midday nap duration, while no statistically significant changes are found for television watching or leisure reading. Heterogeneity analysis suggests that the increase in work time is concentrated among agricultural workers, self‐employed individuals, prime‐age adults and individuals living in households without young children.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了家庭自来水供应是否影响中国农村就业成年人的创收工作时间。现有研究主要关注改善水资源获取对就业参与、非农转移和家庭收入的影响，而本文聚焦于现有生计活动中劳动力供给的集约边际。基于家庭生产与时间分配理论，家庭自来水供应被概念化为降低日常家务生产的时间成本，从而释放出可能重新分配至创收工作及其他家庭活动的时间。利用2014年至2022年中国家庭追踪调查的农村面板数据，本文采用个体固定效应模型和工具变量固定效应估计。固定效应结果显示，家庭自来水供应与农村就业成年人每周约增加一小时的创收工作时间相关。在工具变量识别假设下，工具变量固定效应估计表明存在更大的正向效应。额外的时间使用分析显示，家庭自来水供应使每日家务时间减少约0.29小时，并适度增加午睡时长，而看电视或休闲阅读的时间未发现统计显著变化。异质性分析表明，工作时间的增加主要集中在农业劳动者、自雇者、壮年成年人以及无幼儿家庭中的个体。

abstract: Amid the growing urgency of climate change and the global pursuit of net-zero emissions, green fiscal policy (GFP) has become an important instrument for sustainable development. This study examines the effect of GFP on urban carbon emission mitigation (UCEM), with particular attention to its mechanisms and heterogeneous impacts. Using panel data for 274 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2002 to 2022, it employs the Comprehensive Demonstration of Fiscal Policy for Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction as a quasi-natural experiment and applies a difference-in-differences approach. The results show that GFP significantly promotes UCEM, with stronger effects in cities characterized by higher pollution levels. Mechanism analysis indicates that green innovation and lower total energy consumption serve as positive channels, whereas government environmental attention plays a negative mediating role. In addition, entrepreneurial activity strengthens the effect of GFP, while fiscal pressure weakens it. These findings support phased GFP expansion, stricter enforcement in high-pollution cities, stronger incentives in low-pollution areas, improved transparency and supervision, innovation-led efficiency and clean-energy substitution, plus flexible financing to sustain decarbonization.
abstract_zh: 在气候变化日益紧迫与全球追求净零排放的背景下，绿色财政政策已成为推动可持续发展的重要工具。本研究考察了绿色财政政策对城市碳减排的影响，重点关注其作用机制与异质性效应。基于2002至2022年中国274个地级市的面板数据，以节能减排财政政策综合示范作为准自然实验，采用双重差分方法进行分析。结果表明，绿色财政政策显著促进了城市碳减排，且在污染程度较高的城市中效果更为显著。机制分析显示，绿色创新与总能源消耗降低是正向传导渠道，而政府环境关注度则发挥负向中介作用。此外，创业活动强化了绿色财政政策的效应，而财政压力则削弱了该效应。这些发现支持分阶段推进绿色财政政策扩张、在高污染城市加强执行力度、在低污染地区强化激励措施、提升透明度与监管水平、以创新驱动效率提升与清洁能源替代，以及通过灵活融资维持脱碳进程。关键词：绿色财政政策；碳减排；城市脱碳；可持续发展 JEL分类：Q54 Q58 R11

title: Steering cities towards net-zero: unravelling the causal impact of green fiscal policy on urban decarbonization in China
title_zh: 引导城市迈向净零排放：揭示绿色财政政策对中国城市脱碳的因果影响

abstract: We use the US Distributional Financial Accounts to assess how wealth across the income distribution responds to uncertainty shocks. Following an uncertainty shock, we find that wealth inequality between those in the top percentile of the income distribution and those in the bottom fortieth percentile of the income distribution declines. We show that the result is driven by systematic differences in portfolio composition between high income and low income individuals, with high income individuals having greater exposure to high risk assets. The response of high risk asset inequality is negative while the response of low risk asset inequality is positive. Therefore, the decline in wealth inequality is due to high income individuals losing more relative to lower income individuals rather than lower income individuals catching up to higher income individuals.
abstract_zh: 我们利用美国分配金融账户数据，评估收入分布各阶层的财富如何响应不确定性冲击。研究发现，在不确定性冲击发生后，收入分布前百分位群体与后四十百分位群体之间的财富不平等程度有所下降。这一结果源于高收入与低收入群体在资产组合构成上的系统性差异——高收入群体对高风险资产的敞口更大。高风险资产不平等呈负向响应，而低风险资产不平等呈正向响应。因此，财富不平等的下降并非低收入群体追赶高收入群体所致，而是高收入群体相对损失更大。
title: How Wealth Across the Income Distribution Responds to Uncertainty: Insights from the Distributional Financial Accounts
title_zh: 收入分配各阶层的财富如何应对不确定性：来自分配金融账户的启示

abstract: The regulatory cycles view, according to which periods of deregulation encourage greater risk-taking and credit booms, which culminate in financial crises and are followed by renewed regulation, rests largely on case studies of individual countries or particular crises. This column uses a new dataset covering 14 countries over the past century to show that the pattern observed after the Great Depression has been much weaker since the Global Financial Crisis. The authors argue that the reason is not simply a change in political priorities or regulatory philosophy. Increasing financial integration has made effective banking regulation at the national level progressively more difficult, shifting regulatory authority from national governments towards international coordination.
abstract_zh: 监管周期理论认为，放松管制时期会鼓励更大的风险承担和信贷繁荣，最终导致金融危机，随后迎来新一轮监管强化。这一观点主要基于对单个国家或特定危机的案例研究。本文利用覆盖14个国家过去一个世纪的新数据集，表明大萧条后观察到的这一模式自全球金融危机以来已显著弱化。作者认为，其原因并非仅仅是政治优先事项或监管理念的转变。日益加深的金融一体化使得国家层面的有效银行监管愈发困难，监管权力正从各国政府向国际协调机制转移。
authors: Thilo Nils Hendrik Albers, Alexander Nützenadel, Tobias Scheib
title: Financial globalisation and the weakening of the regulatory cycle
title_zh: 金融全球化与监管周期的弱化

abstract: Globalisation has changed economic research profoundly, making it more comparable, more competitive, and thoroughly quantitative. This column argues that AI may unsettle this new order as thoroughly as globalisation unsettled the old one and discusses the technical and geopolitical mechanisms at work. One prediction can be made with high confidence: someone who wakes up thirty years from now is likely to recognise economics as little as someone who fell asleep thirty years ago and just woke up today.
abstract_zh: 全球化深刻改变了经济学研究，使其更具可比性、竞争性，并彻底走向定量化。本专栏认为，人工智能可能像当年全球化颠覆旧秩序一样，彻底动摇这一新格局，并探讨了其中涉及的技术与地缘政治机制。一个高度可信的预测是：三十年后醒来的人，很可能像三十年前入睡、今天才醒来的人一样，几乎认不出经济学这门学科。
title: AI, the future of economic research and of the many-handed economist
title_zh: 人工智能：经济研究与多面手经济学家的未来

abstract: Equal pay for equal work has been a core EU principle since 1957, yet women across Europe continue to earn less than men, even in very similar jobs. As EU countries begin implementing the new Pay Transparency Directive, greater wage transparency is expected to narrow these gaps. This column explores the potential effects on the 27 EU countries. Equal pay could substantially narrow gender disparities, but the gains are greater where unequal pay among comparable workers is a key driver of the gender pay gap.
abstract_zh: 同工同酬自1957年起便是欧盟的核心原则，然而即便在高度相似的岗位上，欧洲女性收入仍普遍低于男性。随着欧盟各国开始实施新的《薪酬透明指令》，更高的薪酬透明度有望缩小这些差距。本文探讨了该指令对27个欧盟国家的潜在影响。同工同酬可显著缩小性别差异，但在可比劳动者薪酬不平等是性别薪酬差距主要驱动因素的国家，其收益更为显著。
authors: Silvia De Poli, Sofia Maier, Viginta Ivaškaitė-Tamošiūnė
title: The new EU Pay Transparency Directive may reshape wages and the gender pay gap
title_zh: 新欧盟薪酬透明度指令可能重塑工资与性别薪酬差距

abstract: Local communities are widely blamed for the increasing deforestation in Malawi, primarily due to agricultural expansion and the increased use of biomass energy. Yet, there is limited evidence to understand systemic trade-offs that communities face in their land-use decisions. This study examines the drivers of deforestation in Southern Malawi, focusing on community perceptions and the resource Nexus outcomes related to deforestation. We conducted 25 focus group discussions, 22 key informant interviews, and 271 household interviews across Chikwawa, Blantyre, Mwanza, Mulanje, and Thyolo districts. We also conducted seven expert interviews, facilitated five participatory workshops, and employed ethnographic techniques to gather the lived experiences of community members. The study reveals that (1) socio-economic needs for food, energy and income create a vicious cycle of cropland expansion at the direct expense of forest conservation. (2) Community perceptions identify biomass energy production (index=0.0788) as the main driver of deforestation, followed by cropland expansion (0.0769) and energy poverty (0.0746). (3) The dominance of negative ecological outcomes, followed by economic and political outcomes. The socio-cultural dimension reports the least negative outcomes. Nonetheless, positive outcomes are highest in the socio-cultural dimension, followed by the economic and political dimensions. The least positive outcomes are reported in the ecological dimension. The study empirically shows how community perceptions reshape the Resource Nexus and offers geographically specific policy recommendations. It treats deforestation as both socioeconomic and ecological problem, calling for integrated policies that address livelihood needs and structural drivers in Southern Malawi and similar areas in Sub-Saharan Africa.
abstract_zh: 当地社区被广泛指责为马拉维森林砍伐加剧的主要原因，这主要源于农业扩张和生物质能源使用的增加。然而，关于社区在土地利用决策中面临的系统性权衡，现有证据十分有限。本研究聚焦马拉维南部森林砍伐的驱动因素，重点关注社区认知及与森林砍伐相关的资源纽带结果。我们在奇夸瓦、布兰太尔、姆万扎、穆兰杰和蒂约洛地区开展了25场焦点小组讨论、22次关键知情人访谈和271户家庭访谈。此外，我们还进行了7次专家访谈、组织了5场参与式研讨会，并运用民族志方法收集社区成员的生活经验。研究表明：（1）对食物、能源和收入的社会经济需求形成了耕地扩张的恶性循环，直接牺牲了森林保护；（2）社区认知将生物质能源生产（指数=0.0788）视为森林砍伐的首要驱动因素，其次是耕地扩张（0.0769）和能源贫困（0.0746）；（3）负面生态结果占主导地位，其次是经济和政治结果，而社会文化维度报告的负面结果最少。尽管如此，正面结果在社会文化维度最高，其次是经济和政治维度，生态维度报告的正面结果最少。本研究实证展示了社区认知如何重塑资源纽带，并提出了具有地理针对性的政策建议。它将森林砍伐视为社会经济与生态的双重问题，呼吁采取综合政策应对马拉维南部及撒哈拉以南非洲类似地区的生计需求和结构性驱动因素。
title: Food, fuel, or forest? Interrogating the resource nexus dilemma behind deforestation through community-lived experiences in southern Malawi
title_zh: 食物、燃料还是森林？通过马拉维南部社区生活经验审视森林砍伐背后的资源关联困境

abstract: Departmentalized instruction, in which teachers specialize in one or more core subjects and instruct multiple groups of students in a day, has become increasingly prominent in elementary schools. Departmentalization involves a potential trade-off: specialized assignments exploit teacher comparative advantage across subjects but introduce coordination costs across teams of teachers instructing common students. Using 8 years of data from Massachusetts and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate the effects of departmentalization on student achievement. Overall, we find that departmentalization has positive effects in English language arts (ELA) and science and either null or positive effects in math. Consistent with prior findings on teacher specialization, teachers are less effective when specializing in math and no more effective in ELA than when teaching self-contained classrooms. Rather, the improvements are driven by departmentalized schools assigning teachers to their stronger subjects.
abstract_zh: 分科教学（即教师专攻一门或多门核心学科，并在一天内教授多个学生群体）在小学中日益普遍。这种教学方式涉及一种潜在的权衡：专业化分工能够发挥教师在不同学科上的比较优势，但也会在教授同一批学生的教师团队之间产生协调成本。利用马萨诸塞州八年的数据及双重差分法，我们估算了分科教学对学生学业成绩的影响。总体而言，我们发现分科教学对英语语言艺术和科学学科具有积极影响，而对数学学科则呈现无影响或积极影响。与先前关于教师专业化的研究结论一致，教师在专攻数学时教学效率较低，而在英语语言艺术学科上的教学效果并不优于包班制教学。相反，学业成绩的提升主要源于分科学校将教师分配至其更擅长的学科。
title: Departmentalized instruction and elementary school effectiveness
title_zh: 分科教学与小学教育效能

abstract: This study examines the impact of school choice on academic achievement. I use differences in the number of schools across similar Romanian towns, generating variation in school choice for local students, who compete for seats via test scores. I find that more school choice results in increased sorting of students by admission scores across different schools. Sorting widens achievement gaps between high- and low-admission score students. High-scorers having access to better teachers and peer effects are the primary factors explaining these widening gaps. Last, between-school competition via school choice does not increase average achievement levels.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨学校选择对学业成就的影响。利用罗马尼亚相似城镇间学校数量的差异，当地学生通过考试成绩竞争入学名额，由此产生学校选择的变化。研究发现，更多学校选择导致学生按录取分数在不同学校间的分层加剧。这种分层扩大了高、低录取分数学生之间的成就差距。高分数学生能够获得更优质的教师资源和同伴效应，这是解释差距扩大的主要因素。最后，学校间通过择校机制形成的竞争并未提升平均学业成就水平。
title: School Choice, Student Sorting, and Academic Performance
title_zh: 学校选择、学生分类与学业表现

abstract: We study treatment-effect estimation using panel data. The treatment may be nonbinary, nonabsorbing, and the outcome may be affected by treatment lags. We make a parallel-trends assumption and propose event-study estimators of the effect of being exposed to a weakly higher treatment dose for ℓ periods. We also propose normalized estimators that estimate a weighted average of the effects of the current treatment and its lags. We also analyze commonly used two-way, fixed-effects regressions. Unlike our estimators, they can be biased in the presence of heterogeneous treatment effects. A local-projection version of those regressions is biased even with homogeneous effects.
abstract_zh: 本文利用面板数据研究处理效应估计。处理变量可能为非二元、非吸收性，且结果可能受到处理滞后期的影响。我们基于平行趋势假设，提出事件研究估计量，用于估计暴露于弱更高处理剂量持续ℓ期的效应。同时，我们提出标准化估计量，以估计当前处理效应及其滞后效应的加权平均值。此外，我们分析了常用的双向固定效应回归模型。与我们的估计量不同，这些模型在存在异质性处理效应时可能产生偏误。即使处理效应具有同质性，这些回归的局部投影版本仍存在偏误。
title: Difference-in-Differences Estimators of Intertemporal Treatment Effects
title_zh: 跨期处理效应的双重差分估计量

abstract: In 2001 a large and sustained supply shock halted a heroin epidemic in Australia. We use drug offenses to identify individual opioid users and examine how the shock affected their mortality risks and criminal activity over the next eight years. Initially, gains from fewer overdoses are offset by drug substitution and more crime, including homicides. Most adverse effects dissipate over time, whereas persistent mortality reductions save the lives of around one in 48 individuals in our sample. Our results demonstrate that reducing the supply of illicit opioids can lead to meaningful longer-term improvements, even when the short-term effects are ambiguous.
abstract_zh: 2001年，一场大规模且持续的供给冲击终结了澳大利亚的海洛因流行。我们利用毒品犯罪数据识别个体阿片类药物使用者，并考察了该冲击如何影响他们在随后八年间的死亡风险与犯罪活动。最初，过量用药减少带来的收益被药物替代及更多犯罪（包括凶杀案）所抵消。大多数不利影响随时间消散，而持续性的死亡率降低则挽救了样本中约每48人中的1条生命。我们的结果表明，即使短期效果尚不明确，减少非法阿片类药物的供给仍能带来有意义的长期改善。
title: Opioid Use, Mortality Risks and Crime: Insights from a Rapid Reduction in Heroin Supply
title_zh: 阿片类药物使用、死亡风险与犯罪：海洛因供应快速减少的启示

abstract: This paper explores whether and why a maternal child penalty to earnings would emerge even without changes in employment and hours worked. Using a matched event study design, we trace monthly changes in determinants of wages (job performance, human capital accumulation, and promotions). Data come from a usefully unusual setting with required multiyear employment and detailed personnel data: the US Marine Corps. Mothers’ job performance initially declines, and gaps in promotion grow through 24 months postbirth. Fathers’ physical fitness performance drops somewhat but recovers. These patterns lead mothers to earn relatively lower wages, even absent changes in employment postbirth.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了即使在就业和工作时长不变的情况下，母亲因育儿导致的收入惩罚是否会出现及其成因。通过匹配事件研究设计，我们追踪了工资决定因素（工作表现、人力资本积累和晋升）的月度变化。数据来源于一个具有特殊研究价值的场景——美国海军陆战队，该场景要求多年连续就业并提供详细人事数据。研究发现，母亲的工作表现最初出现下降，且晋升差距在产后24个月内持续扩大。父亲的身体素质表现虽有短暂下滑但随后恢复。这些模式导致母亲在产后即使就业状态未变，其相对工资水平仍有所降低。
title: Baby Bumps in the Road: The Impact of Parenthood on Job Performance, Human Capital, and Career Advancement
title_zh: 育儿路上的坎坷：为人父母对工作绩效、人力资本及职业晋升的影响

abstract: P-hacking is prevalent in reality but absent from classical hypothesis-testing theory. We therefore build a model of hypothesis testing that accounts for p-hacking. From the model, we derive critical values such that, if they are used to determine significance, and if p-hacking adjusts to the new significance standards, then spurious significant results do not occur more often than intended. Because of p-hacking, such robust critical values are larger than classical critical values. In the model calibrated to medical science, the robust critical value is the classical critical value for the same test statistic but with one-fifth of the significance level.
abstract_zh: P-hacking在现实中普遍存在，但经典假设检验理论却未将其纳入考量。为此，我们构建了一个考虑P-hacking的假设检验模型。基于该模型，我们推导出临界值：若以此临界值判定统计显著性，且P-hacking行为随新的显著性标准调整，则虚假显著结果的出现频率不会超过预期水平。由于P-hacking的存在，此类稳健临界值大于经典临界值。在基于医学科学校准的模型中，稳健临界值相当于同一检验统计量在显著性水平降至五分之一时的经典临界值。
title: Critical Values Robust to P-hacking
title_zh: 抗p-hacking的临界值

abstract: This paper describes how to reparametrize low-dimensional factor models with one or two factors to fit weak identification theory developed for generalized method of moments models. Some identification-robust tests, here called “plug-in” tests, require a reparametrization to distinguish weakly identified parameters from strongly identified parameters. The reparametrizations in this paper make plug-in tests available for subvector hypotheses in low-dimensional factor models with one or two factors. Simulations show that the plug-in tests are less conservative than identification-robust tests that use the original parametrization. An empirical application to a factor model of parental investments in children is included.
abstract_zh: 本文阐述了如何对含有一个或两个因子的低维因子模型进行重新参数化，以适配为广义矩估计模型开发的弱识别理论。部分识别稳健性检验（此处称为"插件式"检验）需要通过重新参数化来区分弱识别参数与强识别参数。本文提出的重新参数化方法使得插件式检验能够应用于含有一个或两个因子的低维因子模型中的子向量假设。模拟结果表明，相较于使用原始参数化的识别稳健性检验，插件式检验的保守性更低。文中还包含一个关于父母对子女投资因子模型的实证应用案例。
title: Weak Identification in Low-Dimensional Factor Models with One or Two Factors
title_zh: 一或两个因子低维因子模型中的弱识别问题

abstract: Between 1883 and 1919, Andrew Carnegie funded the construction of more than 1,500 public libraries across the United States, reducing the costs of accessing knowledge for millions. We study the effect of these libraries on innovation. Patenting in recipient places increased on average by 10%–12% in the 20 years following library construction relative to a novel control group of cities that applied for but did not build libraries. We show that access to scientific knowledge and increased collaboration opportunities are possible mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 1883年至1919年间，安德鲁·卡内基在美国资助建造了超过1500座公共图书馆，降低了数百万人获取知识的成本。我们研究了这些图书馆对创新的影响。与一组申请建造但未建成图书馆的新颖对照组城市相比，受资助地区在图书馆建成后的20年间，专利数量平均增长了10%–12%。研究表明，获取科学知识的机会增加以及合作机会的增多是可能的机制。
title: Knowledge Access: The Effects of Carnegie Libraries on Innovation
title_zh: 知识获取：卡内基图书馆对创新的影响

abstract: Using Chicago police data, we train a machine learning model to predict the risk of being shot in the next 18 months. Out-of-sample accuracy is strikingly high. A central concern with using police data is “baking in” bias, or overestimating risk for groups likelier to interact with police conditional on behavior. Our predictions, however, accurately recover risk across demographic groups. Legal, ethical, and practical barriers should prevent using victimization predictions to target law enforcement. But using them to target social services could increase both the potential for interventions to reduce shootings and the available statistical power to detect those reductions.
abstract_zh: 利用芝加哥警方数据，我们训练了一个机器学习模型，用于预测未来18个月内被枪击的风险。样本外预测准确度惊人地高。使用警方数据的一个核心担忧是“固化”偏见，即在行为条件相同的情况下，高估更可能与警方互动的群体的风险。然而，我们的预测准确还原了不同人口群体的风险水平。法律、伦理及实践障碍应阻止将受害风险预测用于执法目标锁定。但将其用于社会服务目标锁定，既能提升干预措施减少枪击事件的潜力，也能增强检测此类减少效果的统计效能。
title: Machine Learning Can Predict Shooting Victimization Well Enough to Help Prevent It
title_zh: 机器学习能够足够准确地预测枪击受害风险以助预防

abstract: In markets with asymmetric information between sellers and buyers, feedback mechanisms are important to increase market efficiency and reduce the informational disadvantage of buyers. Feedback mechanisms might work because of self-selection of more trustworthy sellers into markets with such mechanisms or because of reputational concerns of sellers. We show in a field experiment how to disentangle self-selection from reputation effects. Based on 476 taxi rides with four different types of taxis, we find strong evidence for reputation effects but little support for self-selection effects. We discuss policy implications of our findings.
abstract_zh: 在卖方与买方信息不对称的市场中，反馈机制对于提升市场效率、减少买方信息劣势至关重要。反馈机制的有效性可能源于更值得信赖的卖方主动选择进入具备此类机制的市场（自选择效应），也可能源于卖方对声誉的考量（声誉效应）。我们通过一项实地实验，展示了如何区分自选择效应与声誉效应。基于对四种不同类型出租车进行的476次乘车实验，我们发现了支持声誉效应的有力证据，但几乎没有证据支持自选择效应。我们进一步讨论了研究结论的政策启示。
title: Disentangling Reputation from Selection Effects in Markets with Informational Asymmetries: A Field Experiment
title_zh: 信息不对称市场中声誉效应与选择效应的分离：一项田野实验

abstract: We propose a quantitative spatial model featuring heterogeneous worker groups and their travel to consume nontradable goods and services. We consider the opening of the Downtown Line in Singapore, which connected regions where high-income households have residential amenities to where nontraded sectors are productive. Leveraging transit farecard data, we show that high-income workers saw large welfare gains but low-income workers gained little. Everyone enjoyed improved access to consumption opportunities, but low-income jobs in nontradables moved to less attractive workplaces. Abstracting from consumption travel understates the disparate impact across worker groups threefold.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含异质性工人群体及其通勤消费非贸易商品与服务的定量空间模型。以新加坡市区线的开通为研究对象，该线路将高收入家庭享有居住便利性的区域与非贸易部门具有生产优势的区域相连接。基于交通票务数据，我们发现高收入工人获得了显著的福利提升，而低收入工人获益甚微。所有群体均享受到消费机会改善，但非贸易部门的低收入岗位转移至吸引力较低的工作场所。若忽略消费通勤因素，不同工人群体间的差异化影响将被低估三倍。
title: Urban Transit Infrastructure and Inequality
title_zh: 城市交通基础设施与不平等

abstract: We study the influence of workplace peers on a high-stakes, irreversible retirement plan choice. Midcareer U.S. military personnel choose between higher future pension payouts or an immediate bonus plus lower future payouts. With peers defined as those who have locked in their choices and personnel assignment rules ensuring that peer groups are exogenously formed, we capture the causal impact of peers. Greater peer take-up of the bonus, which is difficult to compare to the alternative plan but often extremely costly over one’s lifetime, discourages choosers from selecting the bonus. Peers have special impact within professional, race, and gender groups.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了工作场所同伴对一项高风险的、不可逆的退休计划选择的影响。美国军队中的职业生涯中期人员需要在更高的未来养老金支付与即时奖金加较低的未来支付之间做出选择。我们将同伴定义为那些已经锁定自己选择的人员，并且由于人员分配规则确保了同伴群体是外生形成的，我们捕捉到了同伴的因果影响。同伴对奖金的接受率更高——尽管这种奖金与替代计划难以比较，且通常在一生中代价极高——会抑制选择者选择奖金。同伴在职业、种族和性别群体内具有特殊影响。
title: Information Transmission in Groups: Peer Influence in High-Stakes, Irreversible Financial Decisions
title_zh: 群体中的信息传递：高风险不可逆财务决策中的同伴影响

abstract: We present a new data set we built based on Swiss rich lists going back to 1989. We show, among other things, that 60% of the super-rich are heirs—a fraction twice as large as in the United States—and that wealth mobility at the very top has declined significantly. We find that top 0.01% wealth shares are higher than what previous estimates based on wealth tax statistics suggest. At the same time, we argue that rich list data lead to overestimating wealth inequality. Although rich lists are valuable to study the super-rich, we recommend using reported wealth figures with caution.
abstract_zh: 我们基于1989年以来的瑞士富豪榜单构建了一个全新数据集。研究发现，60%的超级富豪为继承财富者——这一比例是美国的两倍——且顶层财富流动性显著下降。我们发现，最富有的0.01%人群的财富份额高于此前基于财富税统计数据的估算结果。同时，我们认为富豪榜单数据会导致财富不平等程度被高估。尽管富豪榜单对研究超级富豪群体具有重要价值，但我们建议谨慎使用所报告的财富数据。
title: Using Rich Lists to Study the Super-Rich and Top Wealth Inequality: Insights from Switzerland
title_zh: 利用富豪榜研究超级富豪与顶层财富不平等：来自瑞士的启示

abstract: Does monetary policy influence who becomes a homeowner? Lower-income home buyers may be more sensitive to interest rates, at least in part because they more frequently come up against binding payment-to-income ratio constraints in credit decisions. Exploiting the timing of high-frequency observations of individual mortgage rate locks around monetary policy shocks, I find that a 1 percentage point policy-induced increase in mortgage rates lowers the presence of lower-income households in the population of home buyers by 1 to 2 percentage points immediately following the shock. Effects are substantially stronger among first-time home buyers and persist for approximately one year.
abstract_zh: 货币政策是否影响谁会成为房主？低收入购房者可能对利率更为敏感，至少部分原因在于他们在信贷决策中更频繁地面临严格的偿债收入比约束。利用货币政策冲击前后个人抵押贷款利率锁定的高频观测时机，我发现政策导致的抵押贷款利率每上升1个百分点，在冲击发生后立即会使购房者群体中低收入家庭的比例下降1至2个百分点。这一效应在首次购房者中尤为显著，并持续约一年时间。
title: Monetary Policy and Home Buying Inequality
title_zh: 货币政策与购房不平等

abstract: Addressing climate change requires individual behavior change and voter support for pro-climate policies, yet surprisingly little is known about how to achieve these outcomes. In this paper, we estimate causal effects of additional education on pro-climate outcomes using new compulsory schooling law data across 20 European countries. We analyze effects on pro-climate beliefs and behaviors, as well as novel data on policy preferences and voting for green parties. Results show that a year of education substantially increases pro-climate beliefs, behaviors, and policy preferences.
abstract_zh: 应对气候变化需要个体行为改变以及选民对亲气候政策的支持，然而令人惊讶的是，关于如何实现这些目标的研究甚少。本文利用20个欧洲国家的新义务教育法数据，估算了额外教育对亲气候结果的因果效应。我们分析了教育对亲气候信念和行为的影响，并纳入了关于政策偏好和投票支持绿党的新数据。结果表明，每增加一年教育会显著提升亲气候信念、行为和政策偏好。
title: Human Capital and Climate Change
title_zh: 人力资本与气候变化

abstract: This paper reports causal evidence on how the extent of hybrid work—the number of days worked from home relative to days worked from office—affects employee attitudes and performance. Workers who spent around two days in the office each week on average self-reported greater work-life balance, more job satisfaction, and lower isolation from colleagues compared to workers who spent more or fewer days in the office. Employees in the intermediate hybrid condition received no different performance ratings compared to peers who spent more or fewer days in the office.
abstract_zh: 本文报告了关于混合办公程度（即居家办公天数与办公室办公天数的比例）如何影响员工态度与绩效的因果证据。与每周在办公室工作天数更多或更少的员工相比，平均每周在办公室工作约两天的员工自我报告的工作与生活平衡度更高、工作满意度更高，且与同事的隔离感更低。处于中等混合办公条件下的员工，其绩效评级与每周在办公室工作天数更多或更少的同事相比并无显著差异。
title: Is Hybrid Work the Best of Both Worlds? Evidence from a Field Experiment
title_zh: 混合办公模式是否两全其美？来自田野实验的证据

abstract: Women are underrepresented in patenting. In this study, we consider differential responsiveness to rejection as a contributor to the gender gap in invention. Leveraging the prosecution histories of almost one million U.S. patent applications and the quasirandom assignment of applications to examiners, we show that women are 3.6–6.9 percentage points less likely to continue in the application process following an early-stage rejection. Conditional on applying for a patent, male-female disparities in the propensity to abandon applications account for more than half of the overall gender gap in issued patents. We provide suggestive evidence that institutional support can help reduce the attrition gap.
abstract_zh: 女性在专利申请中的代表性不足。本研究将差异化的拒绝应对机制视为发明领域性别差距的一个促成因素。利用近百万份美国专利申请的审查历史以及申请案件准随机分配给审查员的机制，我们发现，在早期阶段遭遇驳回后，女性继续申请流程的可能性低3.6至6.9个百分点。在已提交专利申请的条件下，放弃申请倾向的性别差异解释了已授权专利总体性别差距的一半以上。我们提供的初步证据表明，制度性支持有助于缩小这一退出差距。
title: Attrition and the Gender Patenting Gap
title_zh: 流失率与性别专利差距

abstract: The US tax system allows taxpayers to deduct local taxes from their taxable incomes. Using school district referendum results, we employ a continuous treatment two-way fixed-effects framework to provide causal evidence of a positive relation between the demand for local public goods and the share of residents deducting local taxes. We find that a 1 percentage point decrease in the share of residents deducting property taxes reduces tax and bond referendum approval rates by approximately 0.97 percentage points. Because these federal tax deductions disproportionately benefit higher-income individuals, they potentially widen disparities in public service provision across jurisdictions.
abstract_zh: 美国税收制度允许纳税人从其应税收入中扣除地方税。利用学区公投结果，我们采用连续处理双向固定效应框架，为地方公共产品需求与居民地方税扣除比例之间的正相关关系提供了因果证据。研究发现，居民房产税扣除比例每下降1个百分点，税收和债券公投的通过率将降低约0.97个百分点。由于这些联邦税收扣除对高收入群体的惠及程度不成比例，它们可能加剧不同辖区之间公共服务供给的差距。
title: Federal Tax Deductions and the Demand for Local Public Goods
title_zh: 联邦税收减免与地方公共物品需求

abstract: This paper examines whether regulatory liquidity buffers enable banks to support corporate borrowers during financial stress. Using confidential bank-firm credit data and hand-collected Liquidity Coverage Ratio regulation (LCR) disclosures during COVID-19, we find that banks with higher LCR buffers above the regulatory minimum provided significantly more credit to firms with large undrawn credit lines in March 2020. Critically, only buffers, not overall LCR levels, matter, revealing that the regulatory minimum operates as a binding constraint during stress. The effect is concentrated among high-quality borrowers with clean credit profiles and disappears by mid-2020, confirming that LCR buffers provide selective, temporary liquidity insurance during acute stress.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了监管流动性缓冲是否能使银行在金融压力时期为企业借款人提供支持。利用新冠疫情期间的机密银行-企业信贷数据及手工收集的流动性覆盖率（LCR）监管披露信息，我们发现，在2020年3月，LCR缓冲高于监管最低要求的银行，向拥有大量未提取信贷额度的企业提供了显著更多的信贷。关键在于，只有缓冲水平而非整体LCR水平产生影响，这表明监管最低要求在压力时期构成了具有约束力的限制。这一效应集中于信用记录良好的高质量借款人，并在2020年年中消失，证实了LCR缓冲在严重压力时期提供了选择性、临时性的流动性保险。
title: The Last Taxi: LCR Buffers and Bank Liquidity Provision
title_zh: 最后的出租车：流动性覆盖率缓冲与银行流动性供给

abstract: This study examines how fluctuations in firm-level uncertainty arise over the business cycle and how they influence aggregate economic activity. To do so, it develops a general equilibrium incomplete-markets model in which heterogeneous, risk-averse firms face idiosyncratic demand uncertainty and aggregate shocks to consumer credit conditions. A change in aggregate credit affects not only the expected level of firm demand, but also the cross-sectional dispersion of sales per worker by shifting the probability that firms operate at capacity. Thus, first-moment shocks give rise to endogenous second-moment effects. The model is disciplined using U.S. Compustat data on firm sales and employment and proprietary customer traffic data. The calibrated economy reproduces key cross-sectional moments and business-cycle comovements, including counter cyclical dispersion in firm outcomes. Quantitatively, endogenous uncertainty accounts for roughly one quarter of the output response and one third of the employment response to aggregate credit shocks. The results suggest that uncertainty is not only an independent source of aggregate fluctuations, but also an endogenous propagation mechanism through which changes in demand conditions amplify business cycles.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨企业层面不确定性如何随经济周期波动，以及这种波动如何影响总体经济活动。为此，构建了一个一般均衡不完全市场模型，其中异质性风险厌恶企业面临异质性需求不确定性和消费者信贷条件的总体冲击。总体信贷变化不仅影响企业需求的预期水平，还通过改变企业产能利用率概率，导致人均销售额的横截面离散度发生变化。因此，一阶矩冲击会引发内生性二阶矩效应。该模型采用美国Compustat数据库的企业销售与就业数据以及专有客流量数据进行校准。校准后的经济模型再现了关键横截面矩特征与经济周期联动性，包括企业绩效的反周期离散度。定量分析表明，内生不确定性解释了总体信贷冲击对产出响应的约四分之一，以及对就业响应的约三分之一。研究结果表明，不确定性不仅是总体经济波动的独立来源，更是需求条件变化放大经济周期的内生传导机制。
title: Demand Shocks and Endogenous Uncertainty
title_zh: 需求冲击与内生不确定性
